observations.note: The step read about 208k tokens of whole files before its first write at turn 128 and ran 28 turns above 200k, so expanding one phase at a time (read that phase's code, then write its table) would keep the context smaller.
Three files were read three times in a row each, and one search at a guessed nonexistent path failed, which is minor waste, though the repeated reads may be paging.
